# WoTBTools

World of Tanks Blitz replay tool set: parse `.wotbreplay` battle data, provide Excel export, online damage rankings, battle performance analysis (contribution / KAST / Impact and other derived metrics), AI tactical review (individual / team) and Keycloak authentication.

Entry point: [https://wotbtools.com](https://wotbtools.com) · Repository: [https://github.com/A158Coke/WotbTools](https://github.com/A158Coke/WotbTools)

## What It Does

On Android, replays opened from the file manager are automatically parsed locally (no login required, replays are not uploaded); if reading fails, you can retry. See [Android replay handoff](https://github.com/A158Coke/WotbTools/blob/HEAD/docs/android/replay-intent.md).

The replay workbench permanently displays data, 2D replay, 3D replay, shooting analysis, and AI review. Data and 2D are available anonymously; 3D, shooting analysis/armor recreation, and AI are available after login. Regular users and administrators have the same capabilities.

- **Replay parsing and Excel export**: Browser-native parsing of `.wotbreplay` (upstream Rust Core WASM, files are not uploaded), extracting authoritative settlement (damage / damage taken / assist / block / kill / death moment) and event stream features (movement / crossfire / 3x3 grid areas).
- **Hall of Fame**: Single-match damage rankings for random battles and rated battles; Tier X 100-match career average ranking uniformly uses screenshot + 5 replay manual review.
- **Tournament points leaderboard**: Configure points rules for each round by year, server region, and season; league administrators upload group ranking screenshots, verify AI recognition and publish cumulative points, support draft sharing, post-match corrections, historical points table import, and public leaderboard Excel/PDF export. See [Feature Contract](https://github.com/A158Coke/WotbTools/blob/HEAD/docs/features/tournament-points.md) for details.
- **Battle Performance**: Derived metrics calculated based on unified replay facts (contribution, KAST, Impact, potential damage, assist, kill, multi-damage rate, survival rate, mutual kill), no longer output any composite score.
- **AI Tactical Review**: Pre-match prediction + evidence chain review; team review displays key tactical episodes, training suggestions, points of focus, and high contributors in structured results, SSE displayed segment by segment/phase by phase; switching pages or backgrounding browser tabs during review does not interrupt (including team leader review approximately 1100 second budget, after returning directly see results or progress); point-based victory/defeat clarifies the end method (time exhausted / early end upon reaching 1000 points), point situation analysis based on verifiable signals (kill exchange points timeline / capture point existence /…

CarlosZ16420/hamster-archiver.body:
# Hamster Archiver

### Collecting brings joy, organizing should too.

A local resource archiving tool that quickly creates searchable, easy-to-manage resource archives for local files, recording storage locations and verification information, with the ability to compress and store at any time.

**[Download Windows Official Release](https://github.com/CarlosZ16420/hamster-archiver/releases/latest)** · **[Download Mac Beta](https://github.com/CarlosZ16420/hamster-archiver/releases/tag/v4.8.0-beta.mac.2)** · [English](https://github.com/CarlosZ16420/hamster-archiver/blob/HEAD/README.en.md) · [Report Issues](https://github.com/CarlosZ16420/hamster-archiver/issues)

[Quick Start](#quick-start) · [Features](#features) · [FAQ](#faq) · [Experimental AI Integration](#experimental-ai-integration) · [Documentation & Contributing](#documentation--contributing)

Downloaded/backed-up resources keep piling up, your hard drive is almost full, but you still haven't organized them properly?

- Files scattered across folders, unsure how to categorize them, and reluctant to delete anything.
- Want to back up to cloud storage, but unwilling to have private photos and videos reviewed and processed.
- Planning to compress before uploading, but worried about being left with a pile of unintelligible compressed files.

**Start by adding a resource folder.** Hamster Archiver creates a local repository for folders and videos with covers, previews, and directory listings, organized with tags; when backup is needed, it batch-generates compressed archives, optionally sets passwords and splitting, and automatically updates local records.

**Resources can be backed up anywhere, leaving only lightweight records locally, allowing you to see content anytime, locate files, and have verification records.**

### One Resource Repository, Two Organization Methods

| What do you want to do | How to use |
| --- | --- |
| **Local Organization: Manage your computer's collection first** | Files remain in their original location, previews and lists are generated for resources, organized with categories, tags, and notes in the repository. When backup is needed later, these items can be further compressed. |
| **Package Backup: Store resources to cloud storage or other hard drives** | Batch compress and verify, record backup locations; keep thumbnails and directories locally, knowing what's in each compressed archive. |

The application handles packaging and recording, while storage is handled by your cloud storage or hard drive; repository categories won't reorganize folders on disk.

## iOS App Maintenance

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 16.19.1
MOBILE=1 npm run docs:build

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2
npx cap sync ios
npx cap open ios
```

Then select iPhone in Xcode and press `Cmd + R` to install.

> ⚠️ Release Strategy Explanation
The current Release branch is a daily build: whenever new features or UI changes need to be released or adjusted, Release triggers a build and pushes a new version with high release frequency.
If you pursue stability, **you don't need to keep up with every daily version**, you only need to upgrade when the minor version number upgrades (such as `3.1.0 → 3.2.0`) or when there are updates marked as emergency fixes.

chrisryugj/lexdiff.body:
# LexDiff

**Laws made easy. Smart with AI. The beginning of public Legal AI.**

> *30 minutes with Google, hallucinations with GPT, 30 seconds with LexDiff — with legal and case law sources.*

---

## 💡 What can you do with LexDiff?

When you ask legal questions in everyday language, AI answers **based on verbatim law texts and case law**. It's not just simple search.

* **🧠 AI Legal Search** — "I didn't receive severance pay, what should I do?" → The Themis engine (Claude) directly queries laws and case law from the Legislative Council's API, and provides real-time streaming answers with sources. Simple provision or case law queries run instant (fast-path) without LLM, and subsequent questions remember context.
* **⚡ Comparison of Old and New Provisions** — Changes before and after amendment are highlighted in color. AI summarizes "what changed" in one line. **You can choose the desired point in the amendment history** to view the comparison of new and old provisions at that point and AI explanation.
* **📋 3-Tier Delegation Regulation Comparison** — Law → Enforcement Decree → Enforcement Rule are displayed side-by-side on one screen. Delegation clauses are automatically linked.
* **🔍 Law Impact Tracker** — When law changes, automatically analyze how far the impact reaches. Tracks cascading impacts from superior laws → enforcement decrees → enforcement rules → related ordinances, and AI classifies severity (risk/review/reference).
* **🏛️ Ordinance Benchmarking** — Search "childbirth encouragement ordinance" from local governments across the nation at once. AI compares and analyzes ordinances between our district and neighboring districts and organizes "what's different" in a table.
* **🔗 Delegation Gap Detector** — Automatically finds provisions written "as defined by presidential decree" but actually missing enforcement decrees. View legislative gaps at a glance.
* **⏪ Time Machine** — Select a date to see the verbatim law text at that point in time. Place it side by side with the current law and compare what changed. Move through intermediate revision history with one click. **"View full text at that time"** shows the full text of the law in effect on that day and the list of attachments at that time (even for laws that changed names).
* **🏗️ Reference Date Query** — For questions like "For a sales facility that received a building permit in June 2015, is sprinkler installation required?" that include dates like building permit, construction start, or occupancy approval, answer using **the provisions, attachments, and fire safety standards (NFSC) in effect on that day**, and clarify the applicable version (law name at the time, enforcement date, promulgation number) in the first line. # CODPL

CODPL is a static benchmarking site for multiple vendors' Coding Plans / Code APIs, used for Coding Plan evaluation, Coding Plan speed testing, Code API benchmarking, multi-vendor model comparison, and long-term trend tracking. The project continuously displays TTFT, MedianTPS, comprehensive experience scores, and historical snapshots of different platforms and models, helping developers see real benchmark results before integration, purchase, and model selection.

If you're searching for these contents, this project is prepared for them:

- Coding Plan evaluation
- Coding Plan benchmark
- Coding Plan speed testing
- Coding Plan vendor comparison
- Coding Plan purchase reference
- Code API response speed comparison
- TTFT / MedianTPS / comprehensive experience ranking

- Overseas node: <https://bench.codpl.com/>
- Vendor integration status, purchase links, and official documentation entry: <https://bench.codpl.com/providers>

- Continuously benchmarks multiple Coding Plan / Code API vendors and publicly displays the latest round of results.

- Preserves historical data through static JSON snapshots, making it convenient to observe 24-hour and 30-day trend changes.
- Provides developers, team procurement, and model selection with a public, intuitive, and verifiable reference page.

# KPubData Studio

**KPubData Studio is a workspace for collecting Korean public data, managing it as snapshots while maintaining sources and usage conditions, and analyzing it with tables and SQL.**

> KPubData product family: [KPubData](https://github.com/kpubdata-lab/kpubdata) (public API access library) → [KPubData Builder](https://github.com/kpubdata-lab/kpubdata-builder) (execution·warehouse) → **KPubData Studio** (workspace)

> **Name** — The product name of the execution engine is **KPubData Builder**, and the repository·package is `kpubdata-builder`.
> The commands and environment variables in this document (`VITE_BUILDER_API_URL`, etc.) also use the same name
> ([BRAND.md](https://github.com/kpubdata-lab/kpubdata/blob/main/docs/brand/BRAND.md)).

KPubData's dataset design and normalization process is often complex, with barriers to entry such as YAML editing errors, lack of visual feedback, and difficulty for non-developers. Studio removes these barriers and helps users without coding experience intuitively configure and manage public data processing workflows.

## When you don't need this project

- If you want to directly write build configuration files with CLI or Python code → use [kpubdata-builder](https://github.com/kpubdata-lab/kpubdata-builder)
- If you only want to access Korean public data programmatically → use [kpubdata](https://github.com/kpubdata-lab/kpubdata)

## Installation and Getting Started with Development

### Prerequisites

**Node 22 or higher** is required. (Testing tools only work on Node 22 or higher)

### Quick Start (Demo Mode)

```bash
git clone https://github.com/kpubdata-lab/kpubdata-studio.git
cd kpubdata-studio
npm install
npm run dev
```

# OpenClash Auto Installer

Proxy plugin installation, update, uninstall, and check script collection for **OpenWrt / iStoreOS / ImmortalWrt**.

Already integrated:

- OpenClash
- PassWall
- PassWall2
- Nikki
- SmartDNS
- MosDNS
- daed

---

## One-Click Usage

Recommended to use menu mode directly, installation, updates, version checking, and uninstall are all in the menu:

```sh
wget -qO /usr/bin/openclash-menu https://raw.githubusercontent.com/slobys/openclash-auto-installer/main/menu.sh && chmod +x /usr/bin/openclash-menu && openclash-menu
```

When accessing GitHub is slow domestically, you can use the Gitee entry:

```sh
wget -qO /usr/bin/openclash-menu https://gitee.com/naiyou88/openclash-auto-installer/raw/main/menu.sh && chmod +x /usr/bin/openclash-menu && OPENCLASH_AUTO_BASE_URL=https://gitee.com/naiyou88/openclash-auto-installer/raw/main openclash-menu
```

If the system has already installed `curl`, you can also use:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/slobys/openclash-auto-installer/main/menu.sh -o /usr/bin/openclash-menu && chmod +x /usr/bin/openclash-menu && openclash-menu
```

Full project method:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/slobys/openclash-auto-installer.git && cd openclash-auto-installer && sh menu.sh
```

Menu structure:

```text
1. Check for plugin updates
2. Install plugins
3. Uninstall plugins
0. Exit
```

---

Add to the MCP settings of your Agent:

| Setting | Content |
|---|---|

## Interface Preview

### Office Mode · Light Theme

Top `Work / +Code / Design` triple-mode one-click switching (`Ctrl+1/2/3`); left sidebar divided into three groups: "Context / Capabilities / Office Mode · Tasks", with badges displaying memory, knowledge base, expert library, MCP servers, and skill counts in real-time; input box integrates chips for attachments, @mentions, experts, standards, web search, and auto-approval, right-side "Reasoning" slider supports five levels of dragging adjustment: **Off / Low / Medium / High / Ultra-High**.

### Office Mode · Dark Theme and Custom Background

The same interface automatically switches to glassmorphism (backdrop-blur + semi-transparent layering) in dark mode, supports importing any image/video as a global background, with adjustable opacity, blur radius, and scaling modes; theme variables, accent colors, border radius, shadows, and animations can all be adjusted in real-time in the theme editor of the settings panel without restarting.

### Agent Desktop (WSL Isolated Environment)

Right sidebar "Overview / Agent Desktop" tab embeds real-time desktop view: Agent autonomously operates in an isolated Linux desktop built with **WSL2 + Xvfb** (xdotool clicking and input, import screenshot, ffmpeg video stream), bottom scrolling displays startup and status logs, dedicated input box allows "give tasks to desktop Agent" separately, without interfering with main session. Default resolution 1280x800, auto-restarts and retries if desktop freezes.
